title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — read-only self-service Connection Center UI
purpose: Stack the first honest /platform-v7/settings/connections screen on the bounded Connection Center BFF read slice. The page renders only server-authoritative connection maturity/missing prerequisites, gives a read-only check/refresh action, and makes unsupported/not-yet-modeled areas explicit instead of inventing Connected states. No connection mutation is opened.
boundaries: This slice is stacked on PR #4418 and depends on its two GET-only BFF routes.
No POST connection, attestation, pairing, revoke, reauthorize or credential route is added.
The UI never derives a green state from HTTP success; maturity/missing/mayCarryRealTraffic come from the server response only.
A missing FGIS/transport Connection Center backend model is rendered as not yet represented on this screen, never NOT_CONNECTED/HEALTHY by invention.
No OData, OAuth scopes, client_secret, endpoint, refresh token, raw provider code, XSD or other technical secret is displayed.
Organization-cabinet access is widened only to the registered /platform-v7/settings/connections route; arbitrary /settings paths remain unknown/denied.
Seller/buyer coarse cabinet access is widened only to the exact Connection Center route; server capability/RLS remains authority.
No Prisma, API mutation, provider credential, 1C/EDO live call, hosting or production mutation.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
requiredInvariants: NOT_ATTESTED, ADAPTER_READY and TEST are not visually/textually described as live or connected.
CONFIRMED_LIVE is the only maturity that may say real exchange is externally confirmed.
A service outage clears connection cards and shows an unavailable state instead of cached/static fallback data.
The page requires an authenticated platform session and uses no localStorage authority.
The only active UI mutation-like control is a GET refresh/check action.
